notes.alignment: The crop is produced by the M4 landmark similarity transform to 112x112, not a plain centre crop; this spec only declares the color and normalization of the aligned tensor. The alignment template and destination size are owned by the EdgeFace package.
notes.normalization: pixel / 127.5 - 1.0, equivalent to the upstream EdgeFace ToTensor plus Normalize(mean=0.5, std=0.5) pipeline. Golden tensor parity remains required for this converted artifact.
notes.color_matrix: BT.709 limited assumed; confirm against golden.
